Mini-Game 2

Tension Identification

For each statement, identify the two stakeholders whose interests are most opposed.

format_quoteStatement 1: Compliance vs. Budget Constraints

"A proposed delay in the filter installation will save the department budget significantly, but it directly violates the new compliance agreement signed last month with local regulators."

lightbulbThink about who cares most about cost savings versus who enforces legal agreements.

Select 2 conflicting stakeholders (0/2)

format_quoteStatement 2: Safety vs. Production Targets

"The engineering team recommends a full shutdown for safety inspection, but the customer delivery deadline is in 48 hours and any delay will trigger penalty clauses."

lightbulbConsider who prioritizes physical safety versus who needs timely delivery.

Select 2 conflicting stakeholders (0/2)

format_quoteStatement 3: Transparency vs. Market Stability

"Releasing the full environmental impact report now would satisfy regulators but could cause a 15% stock price drop based on analyst projections."

lightbulbThink about regulatory obligations versus financial stakeholder interests.

Select 2 conflicting stakeholders (0/2)

format_quoteStatement 4: Technical Uncertainty vs. Public Communication

"The company should communicate decisive plans to the public, even if technical assessments are still incomplete."

lightbulbConsider engineering caution versus reputational pressure and public trust management.

Select 2 conflicting stakeholders (0/2)

format_quoteStatement 5: Compensation Fairness vs. Financial Sustainability

"Compensation to affected customers should be prioritised immediately, even if it places long-term financial strain on the company."

lightbulbThink about immediate stakeholder trust versus long-term business viability.

Select 2 conflicting stakeholders (0/2)
